final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description AS d, AVG(ili.product_quantity) AS q, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS c FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.d AS d, s1.q AS q, s1.c AS c, s1.c - s2.m AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c > s2.m) SELECT AVG(q), AVG(c), AVG(diff) FROM s3
